643-5412-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
643-5412-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Coastal Hornclaw ability, giving it flying until end of turn.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with at least three loyalty counters on it

598-728-5173.description:
Activate Liliana's third loyalty ability by removing three loyalty counters from it, allowing you to cast Zombie spells from your graveyard this turn.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
Shambing Ghast dies, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Shambling Ghast from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

851-3129-4094-4826-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Archelos.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

331-533-7839.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature or artifact.
331-533-7839.description:
Activate Makeshift Munitions by paying {1} and sacrificing another creature or artifact, dealing 2 damage to Smaug due to Furnace of Rath.
Smaug triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

849-1263-4871-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Anax trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

215-1902-6633.notablePrerequisites: There are at least six Elves on the battlefield.
215-1902-6633.description:
Activate Wirewood Channeler by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Wirewood Channeler from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Wirewood Channeler by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

339-677-2034-7730.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

3188-3490-4659-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3188-3490-4659-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Social Climber triggers, causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the The Destined White Mage trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

891-1703-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Fool's Demise's first and second ability triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Fool's Demise from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the second Fool's Demise ability, doing nothing,.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability from step 1.
Repeat.

390-877-6967.description:
Cast Hulking Metamorph by paying its prototype cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Honest Rutstein.
Put Honest Rutstein into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Hulking Metamorph triggers, returning Honest Rutstein from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Honest Rutstein by paying {0} due to Morophon and Hulking Metamorph.
Put Honest Rutstein into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Honest Rutstein triggers, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 4.

3025-4050-4681-5170.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Bastion of Remembrance triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Bastion of Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Bastion of Remembrance trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

343-1849-2366-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
343-1849-2366-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Regal Behemoth triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

24-4560-7041.description:
Cast Everybody Lives! by paying {1}{W}, preventing players from losing life this turn.
Cast Wheel of Misfortune by paying {2}{R}, choosing an arbitrarily large number.  Wheel of Misfortune will deal damage to the player(s) who chose the largest number, but their life total will not decrease due to Everybody Lives!. You will still gain life equal to the amount of damage dealt this way due to Wheel of Misfortune's lifelink given to it by Soulfire Grand Master.

101-3542-3647.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
101-3542-3647.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Displace by paying {2}{U}, blinking Vampire Charmseeker and Palinchron
When Vampire Charmseeker and Palinchron enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Vampire Charmseeker trigger, returning Displace from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Palinchron trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Repeat.
101-3542-3647.notes: If you control seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may blink any other permanent besides Palinchron.

1170-1414-2478-6862.easyPrerequisites: One of the artifacts must be in your hand, while the other is either in your graveyard or in your library.
1170-1414-2478-6862.description:
Cast the artifact in your hand by paying its mana cost.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Delivery Moogle.
When Delivery Moogle enters, it triggers, searching your library or graveyard for the other artifact and putting it into your hand.
Activate the artifact cast in step 1 by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

2043-3129-4659-6671.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating two token copies of Magic Pot that are 1/1 Soldiers.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the Magic Pot tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the Magic Pot tokens die, they trigger, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Repeat.

5226-5720-5721-6664.notablePrerequisites:
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
Lands you control and/or land cards in your graveyard that enter the battlefield untapped can tap to produce at least {5}{G}{G}{G}.
5226-5720-5721-6664.description:
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing any land except Shifting Woodland.
Repeat step 1 until you control no other lands except Shifting Woodland.
Activate Shifting Woodland's second ability by paying {2}{G}{G}, causing it to become a copy of Aftermath Analyst until end of turn.
Activate Shifting Woodland by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning it and all other land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

2594-2634-5211.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six lands.
2594-2634-5211.description:
Activate Winding Canyons by paying {2} and tapping it, allowing you to cast creature spells as though they have flash this turn.
Cast Brass's Bounty by paying {6}{R}.
Holding priority, activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, copying Brass's Bounty.
Resolve the Brass's Bounty copy, creating at least six Treasure tokens.
Activate five Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}{R}.
Cast Rootha by paying {1}{U}{R}.
Repeat from step 3.

803-1789-5147-5649.notablePrerequisites: Arcane Adaptation on the battlefield with "Dragon" chosen.
803-1789-5147-5649.description:
Cast Bladewing's Thrall by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Bladewing's Thrall enters the battlefield, Lathliss triggers.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Bladewing's Thrall.
Resolve the Lathliss trigger, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token.
When the Dragon enters the battlefield, Bladewing's Thrall triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2781-3563-4605.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Flicker of Fate.
2781-3563-4605.description:
Cast Flicker of Fate by paying its mana cost, blinking Felidar Guardian.
Felidar Guardian and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian trigger, blinking another permanent you control.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Felidar Guardian that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Felidar Guardian token enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking the nontoken Felidar Guardian.
Repeat from step 2.

511-817-3062-4050-4365.description:
Activate Fungal Bloom by paying {G}{G}, putting two spore counters on a Fungus you control.
Activate a Fungus by removing two spore counters from it, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two Saprolings, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

509-1267-1379-5546.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Jhoira's Timebug does not have summoning sickness.
509-1267-1379-5546.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Medomai the Ageless.
Medomai the Ageless triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Idris by paying {1}{U}{R}.
When Idris enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Medomai the Ageless until Idris leaves the battlefield.
Activate Jhoira's Timebug by tapping it, putting a time counter on Idris.
Move to your extra turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Idris's vanishing ability triggers, removing a time counter from it.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Idris.
Idris triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat from step 5.

2730-4050-5131.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Muldrotha, adding {B}.
When Muldrotha dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Muldrotha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cast Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard by paying {B}, attaching it to Muldrotha.
Repeat.

1495-4613-5338.easyPrerequisites:
Francisco has a +1/+1 counter on it.
The top card of your library isn't a land card.
Triskelion is exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
1495-4613-5338.description:
Activate Francisco by using Triskelion's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Francisco triggers, revealing the top card of your library, then putting it back on top and putting a +1/+1 counter on Francisco.
Repeat.

225-1021-1556-4693.notablePrerequisites: Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
225-1021-1556-4693.description:
Activate Scorched Ruins by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Scorched Ruins.
Activate Drownyard Temple by paying {3}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Drownyard Temple enters the battlefield, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing Drownyard Temple, causing you to gain 3 life.
Repeat.

1245-4365.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures
1245-4365.description:
Activate Tooth and Claw by sacrificing two creatures, creating two 3/1 Carnivore creature tokens.
Repeat.

152-851-1283-2719.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Activate Cogwork Assembler by paying {7}, creating two token copies of Chromatic Orrery.
Activate the Chromatic Orrery tokens' first abilities by tapping them, adding {10}.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead tap the Chromatic Orrery tokens to draw infinite cards, or target any artifact(s) using Cogwork Assembler's ability.

2634-3593-4098.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2634-3593-4098.description:
Cast Infernal Plunge by paying {R} and sacrificing another creature.
Holding priority, activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, copying Infernal Plunge.
Resolve the copy of Infernal Plunge, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting Rootha from your hand onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

381-1661-2452-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Gravebane Zombie.
Gravebone Zombie is put on top of your library instead of into your graveyard.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target opponent to mill cards equal to Gravebane Zombie's power.
Cast Gravebane Zombie from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat.

1379-3525-3576.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Vedalken Engineer.
Vedalken Engineer does not have summoning sickness.
1379-3525-3576.description:
Activate Vedalken Engineer by tapping it, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Vedalken Engineer.
Repeat.

1170-1393-2364-5034.description:
Activate Sol Ring by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Cast Mana Vault by paying {1}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Aether Channeler.
When Aether Channeler enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Sol Ring from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Mana Vault by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Cast Sol Ring by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Aether Channeler.
When Aether Channeler enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Mana Vault from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

678-1652-2034.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Patron of the Arts, adding {C}{C}.
Patron of the Arts dies, triggering itself and Enduring Renewal.
Resolve the Patron of the Arts trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Patron of the Arts from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Cast Patron of the Arts by paying {2}{R}.
Patron of the Arts enters the battlefield, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat.

147-4499-5211.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four lands.
147-4499-5211.description:
Cast Brass's Bounty by paying {6}{R}.
Holding priority, activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Dualcaster Mage.
Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, copying Brass's Bounty.
Resolve the copy of Brass's Bounty, creating at least four Treasure tokens.
Activate three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Hidetsugu Consumes All // Vessel of the All-Consuming

1506-3531-4969.notablePrerequisites:
Belt of Giant Strength and Burning Anger attached to Vessel of the All-Consuming.
Vessel of the All Consuming does not have summoning sickness.
1506-3531-4969.description:
Activate Vessel of the All-Consuming by tapping it, dealing at least ten damage to any opponent.
Vessel of the All-Consuming's first and second ability trigger.
Resolve Vessel of the All-Consuming's first trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve Vessel of the All-Consuming's second trigger, causing that opponent to lose the game.
